name: todoapp-fullstack
description: Phase II Full-Stack Todo Application - Frontend and Backend

scripts.dev:frontend: cd frontend && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 npm run dev
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python -m venv venv && venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run install:all
scripts.clean: cd frontend && rmdir /s /q .next node_modules && npm install
